resources.string: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005: Provides protection orders, residence orders, and relief for women victims of domestic violence.\n

Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace Act, 2013: Mandates internal complaints committees at workplaces to address harassment.

 IPC Section 375: Defines rape and prescribes punishment.

 Criminal Law (Amendment) Act, 2013: Expands rape definitions, introduces stricter penalties for sexual crimes, including acid attacks.

Equal Remuneration Act, 1976: Mandates equal pay for equal work for men and women.

 Indian Constitution (Articles 14, 15, 16, 39A): Guarantees equality and prohibits sex-based discrimination.

Immoral Traffic (Prevention) Act, 1956: Criminalizes trafficking for sexual exploitation.

 Criminal Law (Amendment) Act, 2013: Strengthens penalties for trafficking.

IPC Section 375 (Rape): Defines and punishes rape.

 Section 354 (Assault to outrage modesty): Punishes sexual assault.

 Section 326A (Acid Attack): Criminalizes acid attacks.

 Criminal Law (Amendment) Act, 2013: Strengthens punishments for rape and sexual violence.

Medical Termination of Pregnancy (MTP) Act, 1971: Legalizes abortion under certain conditions.

 Pre-Conception and Pre-Natal Diagnostic Techniques Act, 1994: Prevents sex-selective abortions.

 Maternity Benefit Act, 1961: Provides maternity leave and job protection.

Right to Education Act, 2009: Ensures free and compulsory education for all children, including girls.

 Beti Bachao Beti Padhao Scheme, 2015: Promotes education for girls and addresses declining child sex ratio
.

Factories Act, 1948: Regulates safety and welfare of women workers.

 Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace Act, 2013: Prevents and addresses harassment.

 Maternity Benefit Act, 1961: Provides maternity leave and job protection.

Indian Constitution (Articles 15, 16): Ensures gender equality and prohibits discrimination.

 Hindu Succession (Amendment) Act, 2005: Grants equal inheritance rights to daughters.
